The <b>Grand Gate</b> is a small [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in [[the Citadel]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It serves as the main entrance into the Citadel and is guarded by the [[Last Judge]]. 
 
== Description ==
The Grand Gate is the gate between the [[Blasted Steps]] and the Citadel. Once a lavish, gilded entry point, it has fallen into ruin in the wake of the [[Haunting]]. From the gate, a long bridge leads to a tall, open hall containing moveable scales. These scales can be used as platforms to access a breakable wall to enter the [[Choral Chambers]]. The scales can be tipped either by standing on the elevated ends or striking them from below with an upward attack.

The hall also leads to a lift that used to go down to the [[Underworks]]. It has become dilapidated and gets stuck in the lift shaft shortly after it is activated, crashing to the ground once its lever is repeatedly switched. After obtaining the [[Silk Soar]], the lift shaft allows passage to a shrine dedicated to [[Nyleth]]. It is guarded by [[Shrine Guardian Seth]].

== History ==
The Grand Gate was the main destination for pilgrims on their way to the Citadel. To open the gate, the five bells in the [[Bellshrine]]s around [[Pharloom]] had to be rung, and the bells at the gate itself attuned with music.<ref>Hornet and [[Tall Pilgrim]] dialogue: <br><i>Tall Pilgrim: "We are so close! O mighty ones beyond the gate, we beg you! Open the way and let we poor, insignificant little pilgrims crawl into the light..." <br> Hornet: "I see no gatekeepers to heed your plea, pilgrim, though I too seek entry to the Citadel. Have you heard of a means to open this gateway?" <br> Tall Pilgrim: "Ahh... Weapons blunt it not. No holes for keys. 'Tis the bells, they say! The holy bells upon the path that open the way!"</i></ref> The Last Judge was the final arbiter, ensuring only those without sin were allowed entry into the Citadel.<ref>[[Last Judge]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Final arbiter of the Blasted Steps, tasked to ensure only the sinless ever step beyond the Grand Gate."</i></ref> Once inside the Grand Gate's hall, pilgrims were either sent up to the Choral Chambers to join [[the Choir]],<ref>[[Choir Pouncer]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Agile bug, and one of few hardy pilgrims to have reached the Citadel."</i></ref><ref>[[Choir Cloak]] description: <i>"Garment gifted to pilgrims on admittance to the Citadel. Its thick weave offers additional protection against wind and cold."</i></ref> or sent down the lift to the Underworks to become [[Underworkers]].<ref>[[Bone Scroll]]: <i>"Filthy rag, marked with the scrawl of an Underworker. "So much suffering. Are we truly chosen, or have we sinned unknowing, and now are punished for it?"</i></ref> Some time after the Haunting struck the Citadel, the main path connecting the Grand Gate to the Choral Chambers was blocked off, preventing regular access.

The base of the lift shaft had a gate to a shrine to Nyleth, the [[Old Hearts|old heart]] of [[Shellwood]].<ref>Nyleth Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Ancient heart of Shellwood, connected to all its living things."</i></ref> The Citadel had made an accord with her to build the shrine and send their servants in reverence.<ref>[[Snail Shamans (Silksong)|Chapel Maid]]: <i>"We'd heard the Citadel once made grudging accord with that creature, sent their servants in reverence, even built a shrine up there somewhere. Maybe it's worth you searching for it?"</i></ref> [[Shrine Guardian Seth]] was charged to guard the shrine, with many [[The Choir|choirbugs]] falling to his blade.<ref>Shrine Guardian Seth: <i>"Halt, stranger. I am charged forever to guard the sacred shrine beyond. Any who wish to pass must cross their weapon with my own."</i></ref><ref>[[Shrine Guardian Seth]]: <i>"The shrine remains to remember the wood's first seed, her that once was and always is. I am the last bound to protect it. Sadly, in that service, many have fallen to my blade."</i></ref> Vines eventually covered the gate to the shrine, leaving it mostly inaccessible.

== How to Access ==
The great door that bars access to the Grand Gate at the end of the [[Blasted Steps]] must first be opened by playing the [[Needolin]] after Hornet has rung five bells at large bench stations across Pharloom. This causes the [[Last Judge]] to appear and challenge Hornet. Defeating the Last Judge finally allows the door to open, granting access to the Grand Gate and the start of [[Act 2]].

Alternatively, if Hornet entered the Citadel from the east side via [[Sinner's Road]] and [[Exhaust Organ]], it can be reached from the far southwest corner of the [[Choral Chambers]].

==Trivia==
*In early footage of <i>Silksong</i>, it is shown that ringing the five bells was not needed to enter the Grand Gate.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ehvStZ4r1Kk Hollow Knight: Silksong Teaser Footage (6/14/22) (Xbox Game Pass Promo)]</ref> This is due to them originally having a [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Ending B: Strung to Serve|different purpose]]. 
{{Gallery
|Image1=Grand Gate 2022.png!June 2022 Grand Gate
|Image2=Screenshot SS Last Judge 03.png!Current Grand Gate
}}
*[[Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas#Grand Gate|Earlier in development]], the upper half of the lift room only required the [[Faydown Cloak]] to access.
* Grand Gate is the only permanent area in the game to not have any benches.
* In [[Act 2]], Grand Gate is the smallest area, at only four total rooms.
** In [[Act 3]], this is beaten out by [[Verdania]] at only two rooms.
